$doc: Sacrosanct 3.1 s10.6 / s21.2 — the checked-in dependency LOCK.
This file is the reproducibility control plane. It records every dependency the
Forge kernel build actually consumes: exact revision, archive hash, enabled
features, patches, toolchain constraint, target triplet and expected artifact
fingerprint. `deps.resolved.json` (generated, gitignored) records what a given
workstation actually realized; it never edits this file.
HASH HONESTY RULE — read before editing:
upstream.archive_sha256 is the sha256 of the UPSTREAM SOURCE ARCHIVE at
upstream.url. It is recorded ONLY when it was read from a real source. Where
the installed build predates the current homebrew-core formula, the archive
hash for the INSTALLED version is not obtainable offline, so it is null with
an explicit archive_sha256_reason. A null is never replaced by a guess, and
never by the bottle hash or by the hash of a DIFFERENT version's archive.
fingerprint.* are hashes of the INSTALLED TREE on this workstation, computed
by tools/deps/forge_deps.py. They are artifact fingerprints, not provenance.
Their construction is defined in that file's module docstring.

modes.ONLINE_SEED: FORGE_NETWORK=ON. tools/deps/seed fetches exactly the missing pinned archives into .forge-local/sources/<name>/<revision>/ and verifies each against upstream.archive_sha256. An archive whose lock hash is null is REFUSED, not fetched.

Recording that hash here would be a fabrication. Resolve by seeding the mirror while online (tools/deps/seed) and recording the hash of the archive actually downloaded, or by pinning the formula revision.

dependencies.name: node-addon-api
dependencies.purpose: Header-only Node-API C++ wrapper for the forge_kernel N-API addon (src/binding.cpp). Not needed by the node-free forge_kernel_core / forge::native targets.

upstream.archive_sha256_reason: STILL NULL, and the field name is why: no sha256 OF THE TARBALL can be computed on this workstation. package-lock.json is gitignored (.gitignore line 10) and untracked, so nothing in Git states the tarball's hash, and the npm content-addressed cache no longer holds the tarball (~/.npm/_cacache/content-v2/sha512/73/92/a8d5... is absent), so it cannot be hashed locally either. What IS readable offline is npm's own recorded sha512 integrity for the exact installed version — recorded below in archive_integrity_sha512_npm rather than here, because a sha512 of a tarball is not a sha256 of a tarball and writing it into this field would be the conflation this lock exists to prevent. Fix: stop gitignoring package-lock.json, or seed the tarball into .forge-local/sources and record its sha256.
upstream.archive_integrity_sha512_npm_provenance: WHICH ARTIFACT: the upstream npm TARBALL named by upstream.url (node-addon-api-8.8.0.tgz) — NOT the installed prefix, which is fingerprinted separately under fingerprint.installed_tree_sha256. WHERE READ: the `integrity` field of the `node_modules/node-addon-api` entry in the repo's local, untracked package-lock.json (/Users/account_clawteam1/archdisc-Mech/package-lock.json), read offline. VERSION CHECK: that entry records version 8.8.0, which EQUALS this dependency's pinned version, so the hash describes the archive of what is installed. It was NOT verified against the tarball's bytes — the tarball is absent from the npm cache — so this is npm's recorded integrity, not an independently recomputed digest. UNTRACKED-SOURCE CAVEAT: package-lock.json is gitignored, so this value is not reproducible from a fresh clone and does not by itself make the build verifiable on a clean machine.

installed.note: Also resolvable from $FORGE_NODE_MODULES for worktree builds that reuse the main checkout's node_modules.

known_gaps: SEVEN of eight dependencies carry archive_sha256=null with an explicit reason; only opencascade has one. (An earlier revision of this file and of tools/deps/README.md said 'five of eight' — that was miscounted, corrected 2026-08-28 by counting the field directly.) One of the seven, planegcs, is vendored as a source subtree and has no upstream archive by design, so the archive-bearing deps still null number SIX. Of those six, five (boost, vulkan-headers, vulkan-loader, glslang, molten-vk) are unclosable offline and this was checked, not assumed: the installed Cellar INSTALL_RECEIPT.json for each records source.spec/source.versions but contains no sha256 at all, and no matching archive remains in ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew/downloads. The sixth, node-addon-api, now carries npm's recorded sha512 integrity for the exact installed version under upstream.archive_integrity_sha512_npm — deliberately NOT in archive_sha256. Closing the remaining five needs one ONLINE_SEED run (tools/deps/seed) plus recording the hashes actually observed.
No dependency is served from .forge-local/prefixes yet, so every resolution today ends at the machine-global fallback and warns. The plane is wired; the mirror is not yet populated.
The Apple SDK / compiler is not pinned. The installed_tree_sha256 fingerprints therefore identify the bottle, not the full toolchain.
Ninja is not installed on this workstation, so the spec-conforming presets cannot be executed here; the -make variants exist as a labelled fallback.
